_comment: Curated layer for the `surface` section of docs/capabilities.json (discoverability-design.md §1.2). NOTE the honest boundary: stapel-shop's capabilities.json is otherwise still HAND-AUTHORED (git log: 'author capabilities.json for the stapel-catalog sweep') — no schema/flows/errors triad emitter exists here. `make contract` patches in the two derivable things: module/version from pyproject and the derived `surface`. surface_roots is INTENTIONALLY EMPTY: this module is a thin composite preset (preset.py's INSTALLED_APPS/URL_INCLUDES/SETTINGS_DEFAULTS are plain data, not functions/classes a selector can name) plus one Projection class whose fields (name/consumes/model/source_key/live_query/source_of_truth) are plain assignments, not annotated — the capability_fields selector only picks ast.AnnAssign, so pointing a root at ListingReviewSummaryProjection would select nothing. The one thing a product might actually reach for — reading the projection via stapel_core.comm.projections.read('shop.listing_review_summary', keys=[...]) per projections.py's ListingReviewSummary docstring — is a call into stapel-core's own projection primitive, not a symbol this module exports; stapel-shop itself has no usage surface of its own to publish. Do not invent a root just to have one.
no_surface: Composite preset over the shop bundle. Its one class is an un-annotated DTO, so even the field selector would yield nothing; there is no symbol a product should reach for here rather than write its own.
